title: fix: regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml to fix broken lockfile CI failures
body:
PR #1117's merge commit carried only the workflow cache key bumps (`v1`→`v2`) but silently dropped the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`. All three CI jobs (`Build Core`, `Test Core`, `Build Docs`) fail at `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` with `ERR_PNPM_BROKEN_LOCKFILE: expected a single document in the stream, but found more`.

**Changes:**
- Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml` from scratch (`rm pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm install`), reducing from 14,040 → 13,096 lines by removing corrupted/redundant entries
- Updated CHANGELOG.md
